scripts.setup: pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile && go -C gateway mod download && cargo fetch --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare:sidecar && pnpm --dir frontend tauri dev
scripts.check: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run check:engine && pnpm run check:gateway && pnpm run check:frontend
scripts.build: pnpm run build:engine && pnpm run build:gateway && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run prepare:sidecar && pnpm --dir frontend tauri build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:engine && pnpm run test:gateway && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.test:engine: cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace && cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p encorehub-engine --all-targets --features standalone
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --dir frontend test --run && pnpm --dir frontend test:bundle
scripts.lint: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run lint:engine && pnpm run lint:gateway && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:engine: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p encorehub-engine --all-targets --features standalone -- -D warnings
scripts.format: pnpm run format:engine && pnpm run format:gateway && pnpm run format:frontend
